!
version 15.2
hostname rt-a01
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/0
 description sample uplink
 ip address 192.0.2.1 255.255.255.0
 no cdp enable
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/1
 ip address 198.51.100.1 255.255.255.0
 no cdp enable
!
ip sla 10
 icmp-echo 192.0.2.254
 frequency 30
ip sla schedule 10 life forever start-time now
ip sla 20
 icmp-echo 198.51.100.254
!
line vty 0 4
 transport input ssh
!
end
